temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough and that she keeps thinking whether there was something more they could have done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared for the patient and may be affected by his death, but she has not yet judged how deeply Shirley is struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley's somber demeanor and words confirm that she is grieving and questioning whether they did enough.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is deeply grieving and may be starting to feel self-doubt or guilt about the patient's death.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort Shirley, reassure her about the care they gave, and help her focus on positive moments.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara learns that Shirley feels responsible for the treatment outcome, wonders whether a different approach might have helped, and finds it hard to accept Sara's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is deeply grieving and suspects Shirley may be carrying guilt about whether they did enough, but the specifics are unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley explicitly confirms she feels responsible and is second-guessing treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is carrying significant guilt and self-blame about the treatment and needs help releasing that burden.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, and worry for Shirley
temporal_state_chain.intention: To discuss the treatment supportively, reassure Shirley that they made the best decisions with the information they had, and reduce her sense of responsibility.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive; when confronted, Shirley reveals she holds back feelings because she fears seeming unprofessional or weak and says she will try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving, feels responsible for the outcome, and has been keeping her emotions reserved and minimally expressive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley may be willing to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley suppresses her emotions to protect her professional image, but can be encouraged to express them safely among friends.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, caring frustration, and some hope
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her feelings, reassure her that showing emotion is not weakness, and support her in being more open.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara learns that Shirley thought the previous confrontation was a bit much, but Shirley knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and says they should keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is willing to be more open, but worries she may have been too harsh and possibly strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns Shirley was somewhat overwhelmed but understands Sara's intent, accepts the apology, and values continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship can recover and that Shirley values her support and talks, though Sara should be gentler and follow Shirley's pace.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To mend the friendship, make clear she is there for Shirley in whatever way Shirley needs, and continue supportive talks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved and hears Shirley say she is feeling better because of their talks and Sara's support; Shirley agrees to spend time together outside work and suggests planning something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is improving and that their talks and support are helping, and she feels hopeful but remains attentive to Shirley's needs.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Shirley's improved mood and willingness to spend time outside work confirm progress and openness to a closer supportive friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is doing better, that their talks and support are helping, and that Shirley wants to deepen their connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley, plan time together for the weekend, and maintain their supportive friendship.
